name: LengoPay

sources.quote: Créez votre compte en ligne et soumettez vos documents d'enregistrement (RCCM, NIF, Statuts). Vérification de conformité avec l'APIP en 24h.
L'équipe conformité Lengo Pay vérifie l'existence de l'entreprise et la cohérence des informations.

open_questions: LengoPay asks for registration documents (RCCM, NIF, Statuts) and checks that the business exists, and its sign-up form (https://portal.lengopay.com/register) offers a 'Freelance' service type, but no page says whether a freelancer or an individual without an RCCM can open an account.

description: LengoPay is a Guinean mobile money platform supporting multi-operator cashin and cashout via a REST API.
example_prompt: Add LengoPay mobile money payments to my app.
